create_simple_provider_config: create a SimpleProviderConfig instance from a provider slug and configuration dictionary
build_json_provider_registry: build a JSON provider registry that loads provider configurations from a providers.json file
test_json_provider_registry_get: test the JSONProviderRegistry.get method to retrieve a provider configuration by slug
test_json_provider_registry_exists: test the JSONProviderRegistry.exists method to check if a provider slug is registered
test_json_provider_registry_supports_res: test the JSONProviderRegistry.supports_responses_api method to check if a provider supports the Responses API
list_json_provider_registry: list all registered provider slugs from the JSONProviderRegistry
